dataset.clinical_feature_scope: MIMIC-CXR acquisition metadata: view, procedure, dimensions, orientation, time, and missingness.

image_candidates.name: densenet121_finetuned_current
image_candidates.backbone: fine-tuned final dense block and classifier

selection.rule: Select the image branch by held-out AUPRC while recording AUROC, F1, calibration, and compute; select structured candidates by the same multi-metric view; retain reliability-aware fusion when its AUPRC loss is at most 0.04 and it improves ECE by at least 0.02, because calibration and safe abstention matter in decision support.
